Two groups:
1. DAO forwarding harness (2): node::tests::leaf_dao_is_forwarded_by_parent_and_processed_by_root, grouped_delegated_prefix_dao_is_forwarded_by_parent_and_processed_by_root — parent drops the leaf's DAO instead of forwarding. The leaf's DAO Transit Info names a link-local parent but the test builds the L2 packet with routable leaf_addr, and dao_parents_for_source/same_interface correlation needs rework (beads-worker-5's 17e39dbb31 has the full fix incl. test-harness changes).
2. Version auth (3, flaky/timing): routing::tests::{garbage_version_authorization_rejects_increase, root_authorized_version_propagates_across_two_hops, version_floor_rejects_stale} — process_dio rejects an authorized version-1 DIO at routing/tests.rs:629. Intermittent (passes in routing:: subset, fails standalone/full-suite). Pre-existing in rebased code, not ywec.
3. multicast/dispatch (1): rpl_stack::tests::multicast_dio_and_dis_are_received.
Plus rpl_stack::tests::{root_dispatch_installs_route_and_failures_do_not_mutate, rpl_dispatch_rejects_invalid_ipv6_length_and_checksum, three_rpl_stacks_send_leaf_dao_via_preferred_parent} — the DAO-origin admission path (ywec slice fixes handle_dao but the receive-path test setup needs the harness rework).
Consider cherry-picking beads-worker-5's 17e39dbb31 test-harness changes.
